text:
Although I quit social media, i belive important updates needs to be posted to save genral public from frauds committed by corporates. I will return wherever there is a need to expose. I post this because many quality conscious youngsters spend money beyond their capacity to buy apple products. There is no need to buy it, as smart phone market is already saturated and other phones work equally well for your use. I post this with good intention that indian youth don't waste their hard earned money on apple. Let this message reach till Shri.Narendra Modi: 

A few years ago, my iPhone 13 developed a display issue after an iOS software update. There was no physical damage or water damage. Instead of paying Apple's expensive repair charges, I got the display replaced at a local repair shop for a much lower cost. The phone worked fine after that, so I gave it to my son. However, that experience left me very disappointed with Apple. I felt the repair costs were unreasonable and I was not satisfied with the overall after-sales experience. Based on that experience, I decided to switch to Vivo instead of buying another iPhone.
However, my wife still wanted to buy an iPhone 14 because she creates educational videos for kids and found iMovie and the iPhone ecosystem much easier for video editing and content creation.
Recently, while she was watching YouTube, her iPhone 14 also developed a display issue shortly after an iOS software update. There was no fall, no water damage, and the phone was just over two years old.
We visited an Apple Authorized Service Provider. They charged ₹1,800 just to run diagnostics and concluded that the display had failed. When I asked why a premium phone's display failed after only two years, I was simply told it was a "functional failure." No technical explanation was provided.
I then went to a local repair shop. They diagnosed the same display issue in about 10 minutes, charged nothing for diagnostics, and replaced the display for ₹7,000. The entire repair took about 20 minutes, and the phone has been working perfectly since then.
Seeing similar display issues on both my iPhone 13 and my wife's iPhone 14 after iOS software updates naturally raises doubts in my mind. I cannot say with certainty what caused the failures, but I do wonder whether software updates could be contributing to these failures or whether customers are being pushed towards expensive repairs or AppleCare+.
Apple positions itself as a premium brand, and customers pay a premium expecting reliability, durability, and a hassle-free ownership experience. In my opinion, if a premium phone develops a major display issue in just over two years and the official repair costs are extremely high without a satisfactory explanation for the failure, it becomes difficult to justify paying that premium.
This is my personal experience and opinion. I switched to Vivo after my iPhone 13 experience, and after this latest incident with my wife's iPhone 14, I have no intention of returning to the Apple ecosystem. I hope this helps others evaluate not just the purchase price, but also the long-term cost of ownership before making a buying decision.

For those who fear losing apple's ecosystem - trust me that you will lose nothing coming out of that eco system. Apple needs you, not vice versa. You can still function healthy, have a great life even if apple is not there in your life. What makes me feel so bad is that, Steve Jobs built this to provide premium experience at reasonable price. Once he died, Tim Cook took over, it became operational. If you don't believe me, go back and see when apple product price started to increase beyond justification, you will note that it is after Warren Buffet's Berkshire Hathway took substantial stake in apple. All these are my opinion. It is also my humble opinion that a investment company like Berkshire Hathway that merely exists to make profits to its shareholders, will not think about customer's affordability. They are only there to extract as much money from you, till you say enough, i cant pay anything more. You get it? Thats what is happening. Again, this is just my opinion.
